svg.title: Xiaoran: a topic connects the audience problem, useful deliverable, and opening line
svg.desc: English translation of one topic from Lydia's recorded Chinese WorkBuddy sample. This is an output excerpt, not a software interface.

g.text: A useful topic has more than a title.
Sample brief: a child photography studio, ages 3–8, seeking saves and inquiries.
Pre-shoot checklist for ages 3–8: 18 things to bring
Parents arrive without a comfort item or spare clothes;
an unsettled child makes the shoot harder.
A shoot-day packing checklist: clothes, comfort items,
snacks, and timing — something parents can save.
“The worry is often what you forgot before leaving,
not whether your child will cooperate. Save this checklist.”
Translated excerpt from Lydia's recorded WorkBuddy sample · Original output in Chinese.
The pictured output proposes a topic and deliverable; it does not contain the full 18-item checklist.
